title: Racemiferous
summary: RACEMIF'EROUS, adjective [Latin racemus, a cluster, and fero, to bear.] Bearing racemes or clusters; as the racemiferous fig-tree.

inlines.v: RACEMIF'EROUS, adjective [Latin racemus, a cluster, and fero, to bear.] Bearing racemes or clusters; as the racemiferous fig-tree.
